hero_subtitle: Building secure and efficient software. Uniting Blue Team practices, Product Management experience, and Legal risk analysis.
about_text_1: I am Lívia Almeida, a professional focused on the intersection of technology, regulation, and management.
about_text_2: My academic background in Law (FDCI, 2019) formed the foundation of my professional conduct: analytical capacity to deal with compliance and risk management, resilience under pressure, management of dynamic routines, and customer focus. While studying Software Engineering (started in 2023), I expanded this vision to technology, acting as a Product Owner Intern at Apiki Wordpress, where I experienced agile in practice and supported Product Owners in their tasks.
about_text_3: Today, I dedicate myself to the convergence of these areas: Development in building solutions, applying Blue Team strategy to secure them, and Product Management to orchestrate delivery.
